changes_vs_nb24.funding: a held long pays notional * funding rate at every funding time in (entry, entry + 240 min] (notebook-21 funding cache)
changes_vs_nb24.liquidation: mark-price 1m lows (data.binance.vision futures/um/monthly/markPriceKlines/BTCUSDT/1m, SHA-256 checked) over the 240 minutes after entry, against entry * (1 - 1/k) / (1 - mm) with entry = futures close

missing_data: a 240-min window without a finite futures close at both ends and a finite mark low in every minute is dropped and counted
reading_rule: For the main variant at leverage k the alert stream is said to pay if the 95% lower bound of the mean value per alert after a 5-bp fee is > 0 and the observed mean exceeds the regime-matched null (p < 0.05). Reported for every k; no k is selected.
